plugin.name: NVIDIA Shield remote
plugin.author: NVIDIA Shield plugin for Skypane
plugin.description: A remote for your NVIDIA Shield TV on your panels: the d-pad, Home, Back, play / pause, volume (also to a receiver over HDMI), power, your own button, find my remote, and tiles of your installed apps with their icons. Shows the open app and the volume. Talks to the Shield directly on your home network: no cloud, no account.
settings.name: Name on the panels
settings.ipHelp: Your router's list of devices shows it (or the Shield: Settings → Device Preferences → About → Status). Give it a fixed address in the router so it doesn't change.
settings.codeHelp: Press Pair: a code appears on your TV. Type it here, then press Pair again.
pair.codeShown: A code is now on your TV. Type it into “Code on the TV” and press Pair again (within 3 minutes).
pair.reach: No answer from that address on the Shield's remote port. Check the address and that the Shield is on.
pair.failed: The Shield didn't start pairing. Make sure it's awake (not asleep) and try again.
pair.badCode: That doesn't look like the code on the TV (letters A–F and digits).
pair.wrongCode: The Shield didn't accept that code. Press Pair to get a new one.
pair.expired: That pairing timed out. Press Pair to get a new code.
pair.ok: Paired. Skypane keeps its own key from the Shield; you won't need to do this again. Press Test to check.
test.unpaired: Not paired yet (or the Shield forgot Skypane). Press Pair.
test.reach: No answer from that address. Check the address and that the Shield is on.
test.failed: The Shield answered but something went wrong. Try Pair again.
forget.ok: Skypane forgot its pairing with this Shield. Press Pair to pair again.
err.noShields: No Shields yet: add one in Integrations, then pick it in this card's settings.
err.noShield: Pick which Shield this card controls (card settings).
card.name: Shield remote
card.btnApp: The app it opens (its name, like Netflix, or its package)
card.kbdBtn: Extra keyboard button at the top (the mic button opens it too)
st.unpaired: Not paired: pair it in Integrations
msg.reach: Can't reach the Shield right now.
msg.unpaired: This Shield isn't paired: pair it in Integrations.
msg.timeout: The Shield didn't answer in time.
msg.found: Your remote is beeping. Press any of its buttons to stop it.
msg.noApps: No apps to show: Sync apps in Integrations (Shield remote), and pick them there.
settings.appsHelp: Press Sync apps to get your Shield's apps, then tick the ones to show on the remote. The arrows set their order. Sync again after you install or remove apps: your ticks are kept.
sync.first: Got {n} apps, all ticked: untick the ones you don't use, then Save. Icons follow in a minute.
sync.again: Synced: {n} apps on the Shield. Your ticks are kept.
sync.gone: No longer on the Shield: {names} (tap Forget them to clear).
sync.new: New on the Shield (tick them to show): {names}.
kbd.ph: Type: each key goes to the TV
msg.tooMany: Busy for a moment: too many taps in a row. Try again in a few seconds.
card.appList: Show the app list beside the remote (the apps picked in Integrations)
